recipe.name: P3 Home on time
recipe.hook_formula: Lead with being home, then the facts that make it true.
recipe.image_prompt_template: Our truck pulling into a quiet {street} at dusk, a porch light on, no people, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Team drivers earn $2,500 per week with weekly pay — no waiting for your check. If you have a co-driver you trust, bring the team and apply today.
en.headline: $2,500 a week, team CDL-A.

es.primary_text: Los conductores en equipo ganan $2,500 por semana con pago semanal — sin esperar el cheque. Si tienes un copiloto de confianza, vengan juntos y únanse al equipo.
es.headline: $2,500 por semana, equipo A.

en.primary_text: Team CDL-A drivers take home $2,500 per week, paid weekly. Consistent money in your pocket, week after week. Bring your co-driver and join our team.
en.headline: Weekly pay, every week.

es.primary_text: Conductores en equipo Clase A ganan $2,500 por semana, con pago cada semana. Dinero constante, sin sorpresas. Trae a tu compañero y únanse a la ruta.
es.headline: Pago semanal, sin falta.

en.primary_text: CDL-A team drivers earn $2,500 per week with weekly pay. Run as a team, get paid as a team — every week without delay. Apply today and put your co-driver to work too.
en.headline: $2,500/week, paid weekly.

es.primary_text: Conductores Clase A en equipo ganan $2,500 por semana con pago semanal. Corran juntos y cobren juntos, cada semana sin espera. Apliquen hoy y pongan la ruta a trabajar.
es.headline: $2,500 por semana, pago fijo.
